neighbours.label: the complementizer ' that' / ' que' after a showing or saying verb
fire: A short trip can show students that history matters.
Quiero mencionar que me encanta este libro.
The map is showing that the river has moved.
The study shows children that effort pays off.
Debo decir que la comida fue buena.
Her letter reveals that she was unhappy.
Podemos añadir que el clima es suave.
This chart proves that sales have fallen.
quiet: A short trip can show students the museum.
The map is showing the river.
The study shows children the fields.

short: ' that' / ' que' after a saying verb
notes: Near misses swap in a direct object, so they drop the clause. Relative ' that' reached 0.12 in a probe; the declared token includes it.
